verdict.rationale: Fireflies documents a dedicated 'Meeting search' feature, a transcripts API that 'allows searching for keywords in meeting title and/or words spoken during the meeting,' and AskFred, an AI assistant for natural-language Q&A across meeting transcripts — together covering cross-meeting search and locating specific spoken content. Missing for 10: explicit documentation/UI evidence of jumping straight to the exact timestamp/moment in playback, and independent/hands-on corroboration beyond first-party docs.
